title: narcissus pseudonarcissus subsp. macrolobus
intro: Narcissus pseudonarcissus subsp. macrolobus, commonly known as the wild daffodil or great daffodil, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the genus Narcissus. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including anxiety, insomnia, and respiratory issues, due to its adaptogenic and sedative effects. The health benefits of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus pseudonarcissus subsp. macrolobus are also thought to be influenced by its ability to regulate the nervous system and promote relaxation, making it a potential natural remedy for stress relief and improved sleep quality.
